title: Disney's Vero Beach Staycation | Resort & Room Tour | Activities | Restaurants!
description:
In today's video we drive about two hours from Orlando to visit Disney's Vero Beach Resort and let me tell you it's one of the most quietest and beautifully stunning resorts around. I give you a full resort and room tour from top to bottom and everything you need to know if you are planning on visiting this resort.
